responsibility: Defines Nios II RTL operand predicates and special recognizers used by the machine description to classify legal operands and composite operations. It covers constant classes for arithmetic, logical, shift, control-register, and custom-opcode immediates; register-or-zero forms; specialized memory operands for stack, I/O/cache, and exclusive accesses; and parallel-operation recognizers for pop and ldwm/stwm sequences, providing the semantic filters that distinguish neighboring instruction patterns in nios2.md, ldstwm.md, and sync.md.
